response.sql: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX HAVING AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) IS NOT NULL), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM sex_averages), above_first AS (SELECT s.avg_ratio FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f WHERE s.avg_ratio > f.value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM above_first) SELECT AVG(a.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(a.avg_ratio - f.value) AS above_first_mean, AVG(a.avg_ratio - m.value) AS above_second_mean FROM above_first AS a CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE a.avg_ratio > m.value
